keys.trxIntro: Hand a whole Nexus to another device. No account and no setup — the sending device shows a code, the receiving one takes it, and the copy in between is deleted the moment it arrives.
keys.trxPickNexus: Open a Nexus to send it.
keys.trxServiceHint: Leave this empty to use the official service. Point it at your own deployment of DraconDex-TRX if you would rather run it yourself.
keys.trxAllowTypedHint: On, the other device can type the code and PIN, and the service holds the key sealed under that PIN while it waits. Off, the QR code is the only way in and the service cannot read the file at all.
keys.trxModeTyped: Scan the QR, or type the code and PIN. While this is waiting, the service holds the key sealed under the PIN.
keys.trxModeQr: QR code only. The key never reaches the service, so nobody but the scanning device can open this.
keys.trxExpiry: This expires in 30 minutes, and is deleted the moment it is received.
keys.trxClaimed: The other device has verified the code and is downloading…
keys.trxDone: Received. The copy on the service has been deleted.
keys.trxExpiredNotice: This expired before it was received.
keys.trxReceiveHint: Ask the sending device for its code and PIN.
keys.trxReceiveAsNew: This arrives as a new Nexus. Nothing you already have is touched.
keys.trxErrNetwork: Could not reach the transfer service.
keys.trxErrBadCode: That transfer code or PIN is not right.
keys.trxErrLocked: Too many wrong PINs. This transfer is locked for a while.
keys.trxErrExpired: This transfer has expired. Ask for a new code.
keys.trxErrGone: This transfer no longer exists — it was received or cancelled.
keys.trxErrNotReady: The other device has not finished uploading yet.
keys.trxErrTooLarge: This Nexus is larger than a single transfer allows.
keys.trxErrBadToken: This transfer session is no longer valid. Start again.
keys.trxErrBadKey: That link is incomplete — the key part is missing or damaged.
keys.trxErrQrOnly: The sender allowed the QR code only. Scan it instead of typing.
keys.trxErrBadPayload: The received file could not be read.
keys.trxErrInvalidUrl: That service address is not valid — https only.
keys.trxErrNotFound: That Nexus could not be found.
keys.trxErrServer: The transfer service had a problem.

keys.sbNeedSetup: Setup needed — some tables or functions are missing.

keys.sbAccessTokenHint: Used for this one request only — never saved.
keys.sbManualTitle: Or set it up by hand
keys.sbManualHint: Copy the SQL, run it in your project SQL editor, then press Check project again.

keys.sbErrNoProjectRef: Automatic setup needs a supabase.co project URL.
keys.sbErrRateLimited: Too many requests — try again in a moment.
keys.sbErrSqlError: The setup SQL failed to run.
